name: Design Doc Diff Checker
description: Compare design docs and check TM Forum and OpenAPI 3 standards
about: Drop two versions of a design document into any folder and get a focused comparison. This bot finds what changed, what disappeared, and how the design holds up against TM Forum and OpenAPI 3 standards — all without touching your files.
features: Compare two design documents and surface changes
examplePrompt: Compare these two design documents and show me the differences and any standards gaps.
